cues.title: Smoke Over the Millpond
cues.subtitle: Campaign 1: The Lantern Road  -  Level 1  -  6 Emberfall 1047 AK
cues.text: At the hamlet of Wending Mill, four strangers from Brindle Cross have just driven four goblins out of the mill yard. They had no time to catch their breath. The barn across the yard is on fire, its doors barred from outside, and the miller's wife and a hired lad are trapped inside. Behind the smoke, someone was giving the goblins orders.
Wending Mill (burning)  -  The Barred Door  -  Day
The heat hits them like a door slamming.
The barn's roof is alight from end to end, and the pole across its doors is swollen fast in its brackets.
Stand back.
cues.speaker: brannoc

roll.purpose: c1: Heave a heat-swollen cart-pole out of the iron brackets barring a burning barn's doors, with fire coming through the

cues.text: Brannoc gets his shoulder under the pole and heaves. It comes free at the first try, and the doors swing wide.
Oh, thank the Eight. The lad... he went back for the cow. He breathed too much of it.
cues.speaker: bet

roll.purpose: c2: Get two people who have been breathing smoke coughing, breathing and moving, in the middle of a burning yard.

cues.text: The lad's eyes roll back. Oriel gets him breathing, barely, but his legs will not hold him.
Tamsin, take Bet to the mill! I'll bring him!
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: Oriel hauls the lad to the yard's edge, one arm across her shoulders, and lays him in the grass.
She is still kneeling there when the smoke parts.
Brannoc. Whoever set this fire is still here.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Wending Mill (burning)  -  The Boss  -  Day
Out of the smoke walks a goblin bigger than the rest, in a dented helmet with a strip of glass riveted across the brow.
Two of his crew flank him.
He looks at his dead in the mill yard. Then at the four of them. Then he says something in Goblin, quite calmly.
He says: 'The boss pays for stones. He pays more for the ones who stop us.'
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Wonderful. We've got a price on us.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: Ilsevel. Anything left?
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Cantrips. Only cantrips.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: Me too. I'm sorry.
cues.speaker: oriel

cues.text: Then it's steel. Get behind me.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Nobody has anything left but steel and small fire.
The first goblin's scimitar bites into Brannoc's side. He sets his feet and hits back.
The boss goes straight past Brannoc to Oriel, still kneeling by the fence. Two cuts. She goes down without a sound.
Ilsevel's fire bolt takes the runt off its feet. Behind Brannoc, Oriel's breath catches, and falters.
Brannoc ends the goblin with one stroke and turns, alone, to face the boss.
On the ground, Oriel's fingers move in the dirt. Still here.
Again and again the boss's blades glance off Brannoc's shield. He does not give an inch, and he does not look down.
Oriel's breathing steadies. Not awake. But not slipping any more.
The second blade gets through. Brannoc staggers, nearly done, and keeps his shield up anyway.
A bolt of fire from behind him. The boss drops, and the dented helmet rolls across the yard.
Wending Mill (burning)  -  After the Fire  -  Dusk
Brannoc lets his sword fall and goes down on his knees beside Oriel.
Oriel. Oriel. Breathe. Keep breathing.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: His big hands are shaking, but they know this work. He turns her on her side, clears her mouth, and holds her steady. She is breathing.
Not you. Not you as well.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Four arrows at the big one, Big Man. Not one of them hit.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: You kept it looking at you instead of at her. Technically, that counts.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: By dusk the barn is a black frame. All of Wending Mill passes buckets from the millpond, and the mill still stands.
Ned Hollis comes across the yard with blankets and a loaf. Oriel sleeps on, breathing slow and even.
Brannoc has not moved from her side.
Big Man. Sit down. You're bleeding on the bread.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: ...Don't care.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: This glass on the boss's helmet. It is lantern-glass. Riveted on like a crown.
cues.speaker: ilsevel

cues.text: So somebody's handing out crowns to goblins now.
cues.speaker: tamsin

cues.text: Then tomorrow we tell Rook. All of it.
cues.speaker: brannoc

cues.text: Next time: Fort Harrow, and Captain Rook.
